exposure: Antibiotic pop-up reminder in Anaesthesia Information Management System
finding: Implementation of an antibiotic pop-up reminder in the Anaesthesia Information Management System significantly increased compliance with perioperative antibiotic administration and improved documentation.
mod_finding: The study found that administering antibiotics later for cases with predicted longer preparation times and bringing forward administration in lower-segment Caesarean sections improved compliance.
who: Mothers and offspring (as it relates to Caesarean sections)
